subject: Forest Street Historic District Survey Results
overview: The Commission reviewed survey results showing strong resident opposition to the proposed Forest Street Historic District and approved a residential fence application. Members also discussed a request for a single-house historic district and explored hiring a consultant to help develop a new preservation strategy for the city.

items.title: 16 Hillside Avenue Fence
items.summary: Approved a certificate of appropriateness for a six-foot scalloped cedar fence to provide privacy following library construction at the neighboring property. The Commission found the proposed natural wood materials and design compatible with the district's character.

items.title: Forest Street Historic District Proposal
items.summary: Postponed a decision on the proposed district after survey results showed approximately two-to-one opposition among responding residents. Members debated whether to reduce the district's size to only include the most historic structures or to abandon the proposal due to a lack of resident support.

items.title: 78 Cotting Street
items.summary: Deferred discussion on the potential historic designation of this pre-Civil War property until the owners are formally notified. A resident requested the designation to ensure the commission reviews significant ongoing modifications to the house.

items.title: 10 Manning Street
items.summary: Reviewed a homeowner's request to designate their house as a single-house historic district to protect its architectural integrity for the future. The commission discussed using individual house designations or a 'gerrymandered' non-contiguous district to protect significant properties in the South Street area.

items.title: Consulting and Strategy Planning
items.summary: Agreed to contact a former state preservation official regarding consulting services to assist the commission with strategic planning and community outreach. Members noted that professional expertise may be necessary to build the public coalitions required to establish new districts.

items.title: Membership and Administrative Items
items.summary: Discussed the resignation of a long-serving member and reviewed renewal procedures for current commissioners to ensure all terms and oaths remain up to date.
